Name: Ben of Mountainside Orchard - (Custom NPC)
Author: xetyaj
Description:
[size=4][b]Ben Hurst and Mountainside Orchard[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Ben Hurst is an independent, active man in his early-40s. He devotes his energies to the orchard that he inherited from his father, raising fruit for the ciders and brandies that he sells to Gus. Ben enjoys the rhythm of the seasons and the simple pleasures of local festivals, especially the Trout Derby and the Night Market, and he frequents the saloon every Friday to keep in touch with the community. The closer your friendship grows, however, the more you sense that his cheerful lifestyle masks a quiet resignation that some opportunities in life may have passed him by for good.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Main features[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]As an active member of the Pelican Town community, Ben adds depth and complexity to the game. He is a regular at the saloon, best friends with Gus and Robin, and very opinionated about Lewis and Pierre.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Ben produces cider and brandy from the fruit trees he tends at Mountainside Orchard, a small yet thriving business situated on the cliff overlooking the Backwoods. You can visit the orchard by following the path that leads northwest from the Mountain, just north of the road that leads west into the Backwoods. (See 'Path to the Orchard' in the images section of this page.)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]The mod features over 900 lines of dialogue, 11 events, 2 orchard-related machines, 12 ciders and brandies (18 when Stardew Valley Expanded is installed), and 2 cooking recipes.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Ben of Mountainside Orchard includes built-in integration with a number of the game's most popular mods. No additional work on your part should be required to make Ben compatible with these mods, which include [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37773]Wandering Spouses[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49113]Lots of Kisses[/url].[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Installation Instructions and Additional Requirements[/b][/size]
As part of the background life of Pelican Town, Ben is a perfect inclusion in a new save file, especially one that includes Stardew Valley Expanded. Even so, this mod has been fully tested as a drop-in addition to an ongoing play-through and should cause no technical issues.

Here are the installation instructions:
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Remove any previous installations of Mountainside Orchard from your Mods directory.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download the mod from Nexus in the usual way.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the archive file. The archive decompresses into a parent folder (Mountainside Orchard) with 5 subfolders. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Move the parent folder [i]and all of its contents [/i]to the Mods folder of your installation.[/color][/*]
[*]Verify that your Mods directory has current installations of all six of the required dependencies: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url],  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35751]ScriptCommandPlus[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40185]NPC Pathable Backwoods[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29128][CP] TV Back Sets[/url].[/*]
[*]Play the game.[/*]
[/list]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Triggering the Heart Events[/size][/b][/color]
Consider yourself warned. If you click, there are spoilers.
[spoiler][color=#D4D4D8]1 Heart - Enter the shed at Mountainside Orchard when Ben is present (usually the afternoon).[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]2 Heart - Ben will visit the farm on the morning after reaching 500 friendship points.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]3 Heart - Enter Robin's house between 900 and 1800 on a day when she is present.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]4 Heart - Enter the saloon between 1200 and 1630 when Gus is present.[/color]
5 Heart - Enter the shed at Mountainside Orchard when Ben is present (usually the afternoon).
6 Heart - Enter Ben's house between 1800 and 2200 when Ben is present.
[color=#D4D4D8]7 Heart - Enter Ben's house between 700 and 2100 on a non-rainy day when Ben is present.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]8 Heart - Enter Ben's house between 1700 and 2100 after receiving a mailed invitation. Ben must be present.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]9 Heart - Enter Town between 1100 and 1900.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]10 Heart - Enter Ben's house between 1800 and 2300 when Ben is present.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]14 Heart - Enter the Saloon between 1200 and 1500. The Movie Theater must be completed, and it must be year 2 or later.[/color][/spoiler]


[b][size=4]Artwork and Code[/size][/b]
[size=3]All of the new portraits and sprites included in this mod are the author's own work and may not be used to train an AI.
All of the code in this mod is likewise the work of a human who takes full responsibility for any defects it may contain. Please use the reporting mechanisms on this site to draw my attention to any issues you encounter.[/size]


[b][size=4]Content Warning[/size][/b]
Ben cherishes the family members he has lost and mentions them frequently with love and respect. Once a year Ben visits his father's and grandparents' graves, which is recurring content that is unlocked after reaching 7 Hearts of friendship.

++++++++++++++++++++

DONATIONS
All proceeds go to [url=https://www.againstmalaria.com/]Against Malaria Foundation[/url].
